|lore=The Empire maintains a network of spies attempting to infiltrate the Rebel Alliance or disinform their operatives.
|game_text=Deploy on your spy at a site. Spy is now Undercover. During your control phase, may take one Informant into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. At same and related sites, opponent’s [[Permanent Weapon]] weapon destiny draws are -1 (-2 if targeting this character). (Immune to Alter.)
|printings={{Card versions/Undercover (Dark) (A New Hope)}}
|notes=The Players Committee remaster for Undercover gives official wording dated 4 December 2006. The Permanent Weapon icon in the later wording supplies the same permanent-weapon restriction. The separate Light Undercover publication has its own wording.
